_comment2: Passo dei Salati is one place on the ground, but OSM puts the Punta Indren cable-car station ~280 m from the rest of the hub, so the compiled graph had a two-node pocket you could ski into and never leave: the only way out of the cable-car base was riding back up to Indren. Found by the 'one-way pockets' check in `npm run check:trapped`. Linked both ways as a flat traverse, which is what it is in reality - you cross the station terrace on foot/skis.
_comment3: The same pass, the other side. Passo dei Salati is the ONLY link between the Alagna valley and Gressoney, and OSM leaves a 52 m hole across the hub between the top of the Cimalegna-Passo Salati chair (n1303504790, 2964 m) and the Gressoney-side junction at the Salati/Gabiet stations (n8488819883, 2969 m). Compiled, that made the entire Alagna sector a 36-node trapped basin - you could ride in over the pass and never get back - and it is why the resort reported as only 70% connected ('fractured'). On the ground the two station areas are adjacent and you cross the terrace, so this is a flat traverse both ways, exactly like _comment2.
